descriptors.name: Code Chest
descriptors.description: The CSS and JavaScript of the form open in the native Code Chest editor, and whether its CSS is scoped to the form. Proposals replace a language's code whole and change only the editor's unsaved draft. Each language holds at most 8 KiB (8,192 UTF-8 bytes) of code. PHP is not supported.

page.saveNotice: Review the native editors, then use Save Settings. Code has not been executed or saved by this action.
